verdict.rationale: Airweave's evidence describes collections, source connections, vector/agentic search, MCP, CLI, and webhooks, but nothing addresses customizing entity types, edge types, or an ontology/schema for a graph-entity memory model — Airweave appears to use a fixed sync/search architecture rather than an editable knowledge-graph schema. Missing for 10: any mention of entity/edge type definitions, schema customization API, or ontology configuration.
